properties.company: BE Semiconductor Industries (Besi) — Besi Austria GmbH / Datacon Technology GmbH
properties.site_name: Besi Austria GmbH / Datacon Technology GmbH — Radfeld
properties.products: Die bonders / die attach and flip-chip die bonding equipment for advanced semiconductor packaging (die bonding up to ~2200 apm), plus automatic welding systems for ceramic/metal packages, automatic dispensing machines, and line automation equipment — developed and manufactured under the Datacon brand for MCM, SiP, optoelectronics, advanced/stacked-die and hybrid multi-chip packaging.
properties.sole_source_note: Besi/Datacon is a leading die-bonding/advanced-packaging equipment maker but not the only global source of die bonders (competitors include ASMPT, Kulicke & Soffa, Shinkawa); no defensible sole-source claim.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level figure ("Employees: 280") from a third-party career/institutional profile (mci4me.at) for Besi Austria GmbH in Radfeld — not an official Besi-disclosed number, treat as approximate.
properties.summary: Besi site that develops die bonders and flip chip bonders for chip packaging, under the Datacon brand. Besi lists Radfeld as a development site with 280 employees.

properties.site_name: EV Group St. Florian am Inn (HQ, R&D and Manufacturing)
properties.products: Wafer bonding systems, thin-wafer processing equipment, lithography and nanoimprint lithography (NIL) systems, photoresist coaters, wafer cleaning equipment, and metrology/inspection tools for semiconductor, MEMS, compound semiconductor, power device and nanotechnology device manufacturing — developed and manufactured at this site (per St. Florian am Inn municipal profile: "werden in St. Florian am Inn entwickelt und gefertigt").
properties.sole_source_note: EVG is a leading global supplier of wafer bonding and nanoimprint lithography equipment but is not the sole global source — competitors exist in wafer bonding (e.g. SUSS MicroTec, Applied Materials in adjacent segments) and NIL (e.g. Canon, SUSS MicroTec, Nanonex), so no defensible sole-source claim.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level figure of >1,200 employees at St. Florian am Inn headquarters, from a 2026 Austrian careers portal (karriere.at) company profile; not from an EVG-published annual report. Company-wide figure is >1,600 employees worldwide. EVG's own imprint/global-presence pages do not publish a precise headcount.
properties.summary: EV Group develops and builds wafer bonding, nanoimprint lithography, coating, cleaning and inspection tools at its headquarters in St. Florian, Austria. The site has over 1,200 employees.

properties.products: Multi-beam electron-beam mask writers (e-beam lithography systems) for producing photomasks used in semiconductor IC fabrication; IMS states it develops and produces these systems in cleanroom facilities at this site and exports them worldwide.
properties.sole_source_note: Not a sole source. NuFlare (Toshiba) also makes mask writers. SemiAnalysis (24 Aug 2022) reported that over 98% of production EUV masks used IMS writers: a dominant share, not exclusivity. IMS itself does not claim to be the only supplier.
properties.employees_basis: Only company-wide figures are publicly disclosed (LinkedIn: 501-1000 employees; Kununu: "500+ Mitarbeitende in Europa, Asien und in den USA"). No site-specific headcount for Brunn am Gebirge is publicly reported.
properties.summary: IMS Nanofabrication builds multi-beam electron-beam mask writers, which make photomasks for chip production. It develops and builds them in cleanrooms at its Brunn am Gebirge headquarters.

properties.products: Process research for thin-film deposition (ALD and related processes), especially for chip interconnects and copper, carried out with imec. The site does research, not production.
properties.sole_source_note: Not sole-source at the site level; ASM International globally is a leading ALD/epitaxy equipment supplier but not the sole source of deposition equipment (competitors include Applied Materials, Tokyo Electron), and the Leuven site itself is R&D-only, not a manufacturing chokepoint.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level: ~82-85 FTE for ASM Belgium NV per Belgian corporate registries (Verif 82 employees; Companyweb 84.6 FTE, 2023 filings) — not disclosed by ASM International's own site-level reporting
properties.summary: R&D site for thin-film deposition (ALD, atomic layer deposition) processes, developed with imec. It has about 83 employees and was opened in 2000.

properties.company: Comet Group — Yxlon International A/S (Comet Technologies Denmark A/S)
properties.site_name: Yxlon International A/S (Comet Technologies Denmark A/S) — Taastrup plant
properties.products: Development and manufacture of portable and mobile X-ray inspection systems (e.g. Yxlon XPO/EVO product lines) for industrial non-destructive testing.
properties.sole_source_note: Not established as sole source; portable X-ray NDT equipment is made by multiple vendors globally (e.g. GE, Zetec). No defensible unique-on-Earth claim found for this site's specific product line.
properties.employees_basis: Danish Business Authority (Erhvervsstyrelsen) registry figure for Comet Technologies Denmark A/S as of 07/2025, reported via BiQ Insight; consistent with Kompass directory range of 20-49 employees for the same entity. This is a site-level (Taastrup entity) figure, not global Comet/Yxlon headcount (which is 201-500 on LinkedIn, Hamburg HQ).
properties.summary: Develops and builds portable X-ray inspection systems for industrial non-destructive testing. The Taastrup entity of Comet Group had 38 employees in 2025.

properties.site_name: ASM International Helsinki (Corporate R&D / ASM Microchemistry)
properties.products: Basic/corporate R&D on thin-film deposition chemistry and processes, with heavy focus on ALD (Atomic Layer Deposition) and PEALD — precursor design, new materials/chemistries, and early-stage process feasibility for advanced logic/memory nodes (3nm, 2nm, 1x nm and beyond). This is the earliest R&D stage in ASM's pipeline (Helsinki = basic research → Leuven = process integration → Almere = product/tool development), so Helsinki focuses on process/materials science rather than final equipment engineering.
properties.sole_source_note: Not established as sole source from available public sources; ASM is a major ALD equipment maker but Helsinki is a research site, not a unique global chokepoint site, and multiple ASM sites (Almere, Leuven) contribute to ALD equipment/process development.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount is publicly disclosed. Only a 2003 relocation figure of 10-15 scientists/engineers moving to the Kumpula campus is cited historically; company-wide ASM reports 4800+ employees and 1150+ in R&D globally, with ~650 in R&D across multiple countries per one presentation — none broken down by Helsinki specifically.
properties.summary: Corporate research site for thin-film deposition in Helsinki, Finland. It works on ALD (atomic layer deposition) chemistry and processes for advanced logic and memory chips.

properties.products: ALD (Atomic Layer Deposition) systems and process development — R&D-to-production ALD reactors for semiconductor and advanced materials applications; Applied Materials' own description states the Espoo facility "specializes in cutting-edge ALD systems and processes."
properties.sole_source_note: Not sole source — multiple ALD equipment makers exist globally (e.g., ASM International, Beneq, Veeco, Kokusai). No defensible single-Earth-source claim for this site.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount disclosed. Only company/global figures found: 120+ employees (undated, pre-acquisition, Business Finland presentation), ~200 employees globally (EY deal note, acquisition timeframe), 164 employees (RocketReach, company-wide, undated).
properties.summary: Builds ALD (atomic layer deposition, thin-film coating) systems for research and production. The Espoo site is the Picosun headquarters, now part of Applied Materials.

properties.products: Semiconductor process equipment: Rapid Thermal Processing (RTP/RTA), RTCVD (rapid thermal CVD), DLI-CVD, DLI-ALD, MOCVD, and ALD systems — designed and manufactured at this site
properties.sole_source_note: Not established as sole source; RTP and CVD tools are made by multiple competitors globally (e.g., AIXTRON, Veeco, Applied Materials), so no defensible sole-source claim.
properties.employees_basis: Site/company-level estimate from PitchBook (~22 total employees); LinkedIn gives broader 11-50 range; not an official disclosed figure, and company is small/single-site so this likely reflects the Montpellier site itself
properties.summary: Annealsys designs and builds rapid thermal processing, CVD, ALD and MOCVD tools in Montpellier, France. These tools heat wafers and deposit thin films.

properties.company: Laser Systems & Solutions of Europe SASU (LASSE)
properties.products: Excimer laser annealing (laser thermal treatment) equipment for semiconductor wafer processing — recrystallization and dopant activation of thin films in advanced chip devices
properties.sole_source_note: Not sole source: laser annealing equipment for chip manufacturing is also produced by other vendors globally (e.g., Applied Materials, Veeco); LASSE/Excico is a specialist but not the only supplier of this equipment class.
properties.employees_basis: Company-wide (single-site company) headcount for 2024, per French corporate registries (Societe.com, Le Figaro Entreprises, Verif, Annuaire des Entreprises) and PitchBook; separately, R&D team under the R&D Director is reported as 5 engineers/PhDs (LinkedIn profile, less formal source)
properties.summary: Laser Systems and Solutions of Europe makes excimer laser annealing equipment for treating thin films on wafers. Its Gennevilliers headquarters and plant has about 62 staff.

properties.company: MKS Instruments (Micro-Contrôle Spectra-Physics S.A.S / MKS Group)
properties.products: Precision motion control components/systems (motorized and manual positioning stages, hexapods, micro-positioning/micro-displacement equipment) and opto-mechanical/photonics subassemblies, part of MKS's Light & Motion / Photonics business. Public sources describe categories only, not specific semiconductor-tool SKUs; these motion/optics subsystems are used across semiconductor, industrial, and life-science tools by OEM customers.
properties.sole_source_note: No defensible sole-source claim found; MKS is one of several precision-motion/photonics component suppliers globally, and no source indicates this specific site is the only source of anything chip production needs.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level figure ("près de 200 collaborateurs") reported in a French recruiting profile (lindustrie-recrute.fr) for the Beaune-la-Rolande site, covering HQ, part of production, R&D, and support functions; France-wide total across the two French sites (Beaune-la-Rolande + Brigueuil) is 300+ per an MKS France fact sheet — not an official corporate SEC/investor disclosure.
properties.summary: Makes motorized positioning stages, hexapods and photonics assemblies. Part of MKS Instruments. Public sources do not name specific chip tools. About 200 employees.

properties.site_name: MKS Instruments / Micro-Contrôle Spectra-Physics — Brigueuil manufacturing plant
properties.products: Precision motion-control and positioning stages, made under the Micro-Contrôle Spectra-Physics brand.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level figure disclosed; only France-wide (Micro-Contrôle, Brigueuil + Beaune-la-Rolande combined) headcount of ~300 is public, with ~200 attributed to Beaune-la-Rolande, implying Brigueuil is smaller but the split is not stated in any source — omitted per instructions.
properties.summary: Makes motorized and manual positioning stages for precise motion control under the Micro Contrôle Spectra Physics brand. The plant belongs to MKS Instruments.

properties.products: Vacuum pumps including turbomolecular pumps, leak detectors and leak-testing/leak-control systems, plus related gas analyzers and contamination-control (FOUP/cleanroom) equipment; site handles design, R&D, and industrial manufacturing.
properties.sole_source_note: Pfeiffer Vacuum is a major but not sole vacuum-pump/turbopump/leak-detector maker; competitors include Edwards Vacuum, Leybold, Agilent, Busch, and others, so no defensible sole-source claim for this site.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level figure from secondary sources (PharmaSource: "employs nearly 1,000 individuals"; French Wikipedia citing 2023 data: "emploie 1000 personnes en 2023"). Official French business registries give a broader range of 500-999 salaries for the legal entity headquartered at this address. No primary company disclosure with an exact, dated site headcount was found.
properties.summary: Designs and makes vacuum pumps, leak detectors and gas analyzers in Annecy, France. Secondary sources give about 1,000 employees at the site.

properties.company: Plasma-Therm Europe SAS (CORIAL by Plasma-Therm, incl. Kobus)
properties.products: CORIAL brand plasma etch and plasma-enhanced deposition tools for compound semiconductors, MEMS, photonics and advanced packaging; RTP (rapid thermal processing); plasma dicing process development; and Kobus-heritage ALD/FAST (fast atomic layer deposition, "ALD conformality at CVD speed") and CVD innovation. Site functions as Plasma-Therm's European regional headquarters and includes R&D, manufacturing, and a cleanroom demo facility for applications development, field service and customer process qualification.
properties.sole_source_note: Niche etch/deposition/ALD toolmaker but not a sole global source; competes with other specialty deposition/etch equipment vendors.
properties.employees_basis: Verif.com company registry profile states Plasma-Therm Europe (SIREN 453413692, same Bernin address) employs 29 people; corroborated by Kompass FR/GB directory band of 20-49 employees at this address and LinkedIn company-size band of 11-50. No audited or function-level breakdown is publicly available.
properties.summary: Builds CORIAL plasma etch and deposition tools for compound semiconductors, MEMS and photonics. The Bernin site opened in 2022 and has 29 employees.

properties.company: UnitySC (Unity Semiconductor SAS, part of Merck Group / Merck KGaA)
properties.products: Wafer inspection and metrology equipment for advanced packaging, including 3D TSV inspection, wafer thinning/dicing process monitoring, and MEMS metrology. UnitySC designs and manufactures ("conçoit et fabrique") its systems at this site.
properties.sole_source_note: UnitySC is one of several wafer/advanced-packaging metrology and inspection equipment suppliers globally (competitors include KLA, Onto Innovation, Nordson/CyberOptics); no defensible sole-source claim identified.
properties.employees_basis: Company-wide (not site-specific) headcount of ~160 employees (~70 in R&D), per Merck's July 2024 acquisition announcement (emdgroup.com press release). No source breaks this down by individual site, but UnitySC is a small, single-HQ company so the vast majority is presumed to be at Montbonnot-Saint-Martin. Third-party databases (ZoomInfo ~98, LinkedIn 51-200 band) are less authoritative and inconsistent.
properties.summary: UnitySC designs and builds wafer inspection and metrology tools in Montbonnot-Saint-Martin, France. They cover TSV inspection, wafer thinning monitoring and MEMS. Merck owns the company.

properties.products: Laser micromachining and laser dicing (TLS-dicing) systems for wafer singulation and semiconductor/glass/PV/display/medtech processing, including microDICE (laser dicing), microFLEX (roll-to-roll laser processing), microPREP PRO (laser sample prep for microelectronics/materials analysis), microPRO XS OCF, and microVEGA xMR (magnetic sensor/xMR processing)
properties.sole_source_note: Not sole source - laser micromachining/dicing (including thermal laser separation, TLS-dicing) is a competitive market with other suppliers (e.g., ADT, DISCO for mechanical/laser dicing alternatives); no defensible unique-on-Earth claim found.
properties.employees_basis: Company-wide (not site-specific): LinkedIn lists 51-200 employees, ZoomInfo lists ~190, Photonics Buyers' Guide lists 175 - no source breaks out headcount specifically for the Chemnitz site, so site-level employees omitted
properties.summary: 3D-Micromac in Chemnitz builds laser dicing and micromachining systems for wafers, glass and solar materials. The site is its headquarters.

properties.products: Precision optomechanical components for ASML's DUV and EUV lithography systems: wafer tables/wafer clamps, reticle chucks (reticle stages), and mirror blocks/mirror-block modules; site specializes in optical fabrication and high-precision (opto-mechanical) manufacturing of these lithography subsystems.
properties.sole_source_note: Not established as sole-source at the component level from available sources; ASML overall is the sole global supplier of EUV lithography scanners, but that sole-source claim attaches to ASML's EUV systems business (Veldhoven-centered), not specifically and exclusively to this Berlin optics/wafer-chuck manufacturing site, which is one of several ASML component sites. Leaving false pending more specific sourcing on whether Berlin-made mirror blocks/chucks are uniquely irreplaceable.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level headcount ("over 1,700 employees") as stated on ASML's own Berlin location page (asml.com/company/about-asml/locations/berlin); older sources cite 1,200-1,600, treated as superseded.
properties.summary: Makes wafer tables, reticle chucks and mirror blocks for ASML lithography machines. About 1,700 people work here. Opened in 2020.

properties.products: R&D for SoC (system-on-chip) test systems targeting high-power devices, microcontrollers, and automotive components. Site also houses Advantest's largest repair center and its customer support team (service functions, not manufacturing per available sources).
properties.summary: Research and development of SoC (system on chip) test systems for high-power devices, microcontrollers and automotive chips. It also hosts a repair center.

properties.products: ASIC design and hardware R&D for semiconductor SoC (system-on-chip) automated test equipment (ATE); prototype development for AI, automotive, and 5G test system applications
properties.sole_source_note: Advantest is one of several major ATE (automated test equipment) vendors globally (alongside Teradyne, etc.); Berlin site is one of multiple Advantest R&D locations, not a unique/sole-source capability.
properties.employees_basis: Not disclosed at site level; no public Berlin-specific headcount figure found
properties.summary: Hardware research and development site for SoC (system on chip) test equipment in Berlin, Germany. It designs ASICs and builds prototypes for AI, automotive and 5G test systems.

properties.products: SoC test system R&D (V93000 ATE platform) for AI, automotive, 5G chips; prototype production of test systems
properties.sole_source_note: Advantest is a leading but not sole-source ATE vendor (Teradyne is a major competitor); Böblingen itself is an R&D/prototype site, not a unique global chokepoint.
properties.employees_basis: Company career-site statement: Böblingen is Advantest's largest R&D site outside Japan with around 850 employees (site-level, self-reported).
properties.summary: Develops SoC (system on chip) test systems on the V93000 platform and builds prototypes. It is a research site with 850 employees, not a volume plant.

properties.products: Hardware and software for product-scaling solutions on the V93000 SoC test platform (semiconductor ATE - automated test equipment); includes design, assembly, and prototyping of these products at the site.
properties.sole_source_note: Advantest is a major but not sole-source supplier of SoC automated test equipment; competitors (e.g., Teradyne) also make ATE for chip testing.
properties.employees_basis: not disclosed at site level; no public source breaks out Duisburg headcount separately from Advantest Europe GmbH
properties.summary: Advantest in Duisburg designs, assembles and prototypes hardware and software for the V93000 chip test platform. This automated test equipment checks finished chips.

properties.products: Test-system R&D, application/solution engineering, and customer/technical support for Advantest's semiconductor test systems (SoC, memory, power semiconductor testers); no on-site manufacturing evidenced.
properties.employees_basis: Not disclosed at site level; no public source gives Munich-specific or Advantest Europe GmbH-wide headcount
properties.summary: Advantest Europe in Munich does research, application engineering and customer support for chip test systems. The site is the company's European headquarters and has no recorded manufacturing.

properties.products: MOCVD (metal-organic chemical vapor deposition) systems for compound semiconductor production (GaN, SiC power/RF devices, LEDs, photonics); R&D and innovation center for deposition technology
properties.sole_source_note: Aixtron is a leading but not sole global MOCVD equipment supplier; competitors exist (e.g. Veeco in the US), so not a defensible sole-source claim.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount publicly disclosed; only global figures found (LinkedIn: 1,001-5,000 global employees; a third-party profile cites 764 total, not verified as company-published or Herzogenrath-specific) — omitted per instructions
properties.summary: Headquarters of Aixtron. Makes MOCVD (metal organic vapor deposition) systems for GaN (gallium nitride) and SiC (silicon carbide) devices, LEDs and photonics.

properties.company: Busch Vacuum Solutions (Busch Group) — Busch Produktions GmbH
properties.site_name: Busch Produktions GmbH / Busch SE Headquarters, Maulburg
properties.products: Vacuum pumps, vacuum systems, blowers and compressors for industry and for chip making.
properties.sole_source_note: Busch is a large, established vacuum pump manufacturer but not the sole source of dry/rotary vane vacuum pumps for semiconductor sub-fab use — multiple competitors (Pfeiffer Vacuum, Edwards/Atlas Copco, Leybold) supply comparable equipment.
properties.employees_basis: Only global Busch Group headcount is publicly disclosed (8,337 employees, 2024, per German Wikipedia). No site-level figure for Maulburg or for Busch Produktions GmbH specifically is publicly available.
properties.summary: Headquarters and production plant for vacuum pumps, vacuum systems, blowers and compressors. Busch Group had 8,337 employees worldwide in 2024.

properties.products: Special equipment for making and testing lithography systems, and precision mechanical and mechatronic parts such as actuators. The site was the lithography division of Beyond Gravity (formerly RUAG) until ZEISS SMT bought it.
properties.sole_source_note: Coswig makes mechatronic/precision components and assemblies for lithography equipment, but public sources do not establish it as the sole global source of any specific component; the EUV optics core (where ZEISS SMT is genuinely sole-source globally) is attributed to Oberkochen/Wetzlar, not Coswig.
properties.employees_basis: Combined figure only: ~200-210 employees across the two acquired Lithography-division production sites (Zurich, Switzerland + Coswig, Germany) at time of the Beyond Gravity-to-ZEISS SMT transfer (per Beyond Gravity/Silicon Saxony press releases). No Coswig-only headcount is publicly disclosed.
properties.summary: Makes precision mechanical and mechatronic components for lithography systems in Coswig, Germany. Carl Zeiss SMT took the site over from Beyond Gravity.

employees.note: Zeiss gives about 220 employees for Coswig and Zurich together (Beyond Gravity lithography division, closed 1 Dec 2024); no per-site figure was found.

properties.products: Photomask repair, qualification, and metrology systems (ZEISS Semiconductor Mask Solutions / SMS) — systems that analyze and repair defects on photomasks and measure/optimize defined mask properties; site also historically associated with lithography optics development/production.
properties.sole_source_note: Not established as sole source from available sources; ZEISS SMT is a leading but not sole provider of photomask repair/metrology tools.
properties.employees_basis: 2018 ZEISS SMT fact sheet lists 2,100 employees for the Jena site (production and development site); no more recent site-specific figure found publicly — figure may be dated.
properties.summary: Makes photomask repair and measurement systems for chip production. The Zeiss site in Jena has about 2,100 employees and has been a lithography optics site since 2006.

properties.products: Lithography optics and illumination systems for DUV wafer scanners (development and manufacture); optics, coating, and assembly for semiconductor lithography equipment.
properties.sole_source_note: Not defensible at site level: public sources confirm DUV illumination system manufacture at Wetzlar but do not attribute EUV optics/mirror production specifically to this site (that is associated with SMT more broadly / Oberkochen), so no site-specific sole-source claim can be substantiated.
properties.employees_basis: Zeiss 2023 press release: expansion (Dillfeld factory) will bring SMT Wetzlar to "over 500 jobs" once complete (targeted 2025); adds 150 new production/development jobs to existing site. No exact current site headcount disclosed; not a global-only figure.
properties.summary: Zeiss SMT in Wetzlar, Germany, develops and makes optics and illumination systems for DUV lithography scanners. A 2023 expansion adds 150 jobs, bringing the site to over 500.

year_opened.note: Zeiss still called the new Wetzlar factory under construction in July 2026; 2025 was only the target.

properties.products: Publicly documented Carl Zeiss SMT activity centers on lithography optics (projection optics, illumination systems) for EUV/DUV semiconductor manufacturing equipment, but no public source specifies what is actually developed or made at the Aachen site specifically — Zeiss documentation attributes projection-optics development/manufacturing to Oberkochen and illumination-system production to Wetzlar, not Aachen. Aachen appears only as one of several listed SMT business-group sites (alongside Jena, Wetzlar, Roßdorf, Coswig, Zurich, Dublin, Bar Lev).
properties.sole_source_note: Cannot justify a sole_source claim for this specific site since its function is not publicly disclosed; Zeiss SMT overall is a leading/near-sole source of EUV lithography optics, but that claim attaches to Oberkochen, not Aachen.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount for Aachen is publicly disclosed. Only group-level figures exist: Carl Zeiss SMT business group ~9,349 employees (2025, Wikipedia/Zeiss); Zeiss Group overall 46,622 employees (2025); Zeiss SMT LinkedIn shows 5,001-10,000 (org-wide, not site-specific).
properties.summary: Carl Zeiss SMT is known for lithography optics for EUV and DUV chip machines. Public sources do not say what the Aachen site does.

properties.products: Projection optics (lens/mirror systems) for DUV and EUV lithography scanners; development of illumination systems for lithography; core engineering/R&D for ZEISS SMT's semiconductor optics portfolio, including EUV mirror technology and High-NA EUV projection optics
properties.sole_source_note: ASML's 2025 annual report calls Carl Zeiss SMT GmbH 'our single supplier of optical columns' (ASML holds a 24.9% interest in the Zeiss SMT holding company). Oberkochen is Zeiss SMT's headquarters, where projection optics are developed and made.
properties.employees_basis: Only group-level figure disclosed: Carl Zeiss SMT (all business group, 9 global locations) had 9,349 employees as of 2025 per Wikipedia (citing company data); no site-level Oberkochen headcount is publicly disclosed
properties.summary: Makes projection optics for DUV and EUV lithography machines. ASML's 2025 annual report calls Carl Zeiss SMT its single supplier of optical columns.

properties.products: R&D and service for high-precision photomask repair systems (MeRiT mask repair tools using gas-assisted electron-beam lithography) and mask-related metrology/process control solutions for defect-free photomask production; supports EUV/High-NA-EUV lithography indirectly via mask repair, not optics manufacturing
properties.sole_source_note: Not established as sole source; ZEISS MeRiT mask repair systems are a leading but not confirmed-unique technology (other mask repair vendors, e.g. mask metrology/repair tools from other suppliers, may exist). No defensible sole-source claim from available sources.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level headcount disclosed in Zeiss's 2025 press release on the Rossdorf cleanroom expansion: ~80 employees in 2015, ~280 employees by 2025
properties.summary: Research and service site for photomask repair systems that use electron beams. It grew from about 80 staff in 2015 to about 280 in 2025.

year_opened.note: 2015 was a headcount year; Zeiss bought NaWoTec, the Rossdorf business, in 2005. The opening year was not found.

properties.company: Comet Group (Comet Yxlon GmbH / Comet Plasma Control Technologies)
properties.site_name: Comet PCT (Plasma Control Technologies) - RF Generator Center of Excellence
properties.products: RF (radio-frequency) generators for plasma processes used in semiconductor, display/touch-panel and other plasma-based manufacturing; site handles development, production and fully automated testing of RF generators. No public evidence that matching networks or vacuum capacitors (also part of PCT's portfolio) are made at this specific site.
properties.sole_source_note: Comet PCT (successor to Truempf Huettinger's plasma RF business) is a leading maker of RF generators/matching networks for semiconductor plasma processes, but competitors exist (e.g., MKS Instruments/ENI, Advanced Energy) — not a defensible sole-source claim.
properties.employees_basis: Not disclosed at site level in any available source (annual reports, job postings, LinkedIn, directories all omit Aachen headcount).
properties.summary: Develops, makes and tests RF (radio-frequency) generators for plasma processes in Aachen, Germany. The generators serve semiconductor and display manufacturing.

properties.company: Comet Group — Comet Yxlon GmbH (formerly Yxlon International GmbH)
properties.site_name: Comet Yxlon GmbH — Hamburg Headquarters, R&D & Manufacturing (IXS division)
properties.products: Industrial X-ray and CT inspection systems (2D/3D) for board- and component-level inspection, including automated X-ray inspection (AXI) equipment used in electronics/semiconductor packaging and casting/weld inspection across industries; developed, produced, and marketed at this site.
properties.sole_source_note: Not sole source — multiple industrial X-ray/CT inspection vendors exist globally (e.g., Nordson DAGE, Test Research Inc., SAKI, Viscom). Comet Yxlon is a leading but not sole provider of this equipment class.
properties.employees_basis: Comet Yxlon division-wide (worldwide) headcount from 2024 Comet Yxlon company presentation ("430 employees worldwide"); not Hamburg-site-specific. LinkedIn lists 201-500 employee band, consistent. No verified Hamburg-only figure found; an older export-database entry lists "101-250" for the entity but attribution to Hamburg alone and currency are unclear.
properties.summary: Headquarters of Comet Yxlon, which develops and builds industrial X-ray and CT inspection systems, including automated inspection of chip packages. It has 430 employees.

properties.products: Advanced Packaging back-end equipment: automatic wafer/panel debonders and warpage handling/measurement/adjustment tools for FOWLP/FOPLP processes
properties.sole_source_note: No defensible sole-source claim found; debonding/warpage equipment market has other suppliers (e.g., EV Group, SUSS MicroTec) — ERS is a specialist but not the only source on Earth for these tool classes.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount disclosed; only company-wide range (51-200 employees, per ContactOut/ZoomInfo-type aggregator, not company-confirmed)
properties.summary: ERS electronic in Barbing, Germany, makes wafer and panel debonders plus warpage measurement and adjustment tools. They are used in fan-out packaging processes.

properties.site_name: ERS electronic GmbH HQ / Engineering Center / Production
properties.products: Thermal chuck systems and thermal test solutions for wafer test (front-end) and semiconductor packaging/wafer-level packaging (back-end), including AirCool thermal control technology, debonders, and warpage adjustment tools
properties.sole_source_note: ERS is a notable specialist and pioneer in thermal wafer test chucks (AirCool technology) but is not documented as the sole global source for thermal test equipment — competitors exist (e.g., Temptronic/inTEST, Cascade Microtech/FormFactor). No defensible sole-source claim found.
properties.employees_basis: No official site-level figure disclosed by ERS itself; third-party directories give conflicting estimates (61, 100-200, 107 employees) — treat as approximate, not authoritative
properties.summary: ERS electronic in Germering makes thermal chuck systems that hold and temperature-control wafers during test and packaging. The company has about 100 staff at its headquarters.

properties.products: Wire bonding machines for semiconductor/MEMS packaging: ball-wedge bonders, wedge-wedge bonders, heavy wire and thin wire bonders, and laser bonding systems.
properties.sole_source_note: Not sole source — several other companies worldwide (e.g., ASMPT, Kulicke & Soffa, Hesse GmbH, West-Bond) also manufacture wire bonders for semiconductor packaging.
properties.employees_basis: Company-wide (not site-specific) estimate: LinkedIn lists 51-200 employees; PitchBook lists 54 total; Productronica exhibitor profile states "around 100 people." Since Ottobrunn is the sole HQ/manufacturing site, this range plausibly approximates on-site headcount, but no source discloses a site-specific figure — treat as low-confidence midpoint estimate, not a verified site number.
properties.summary: Headquarters and factory for wire bonding machines used in chip and MEMS (micro machined sensor) packaging. About 75 employees.

properties.products: Precision die bonders, flip-chip bonders, and rework/placement equipment used in semiconductor and electronics packaging (back-end assembly equipment)
properties.sole_source_note: Finetech is one of several global suppliers of precision die-bonding/rework equipment (competitors include Kulicke & Soffa, Palomar Technologies, Hesse Mechatronics, etc.); no defensible sole-source claim for chip production overall.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount disclosed; only company-wide third-party estimates exist (Kompass: 100-249 employees; LinkedIn: 51-200 employees) — not attributable specifically to this Berlin-Marzahn site
properties.summary: Headquarters and production site for die bonders, flip chip bonders and rework equipment used in chip packaging. The Berlin site opened in 2015.

properties.site_name: Heidelberg Instruments Mikrotechnik GmbH — HQ, Production & R&D Center (Wieblingen)
properties.products: Maskless (direct-write) laser lithography systems, maskless aligners, and nanofabrication tools for photomask making and micro/nanopatterning — designed, developed, and manufactured on-site.
properties.sole_source_note: Heidelberg Instruments is a leading maskless/direct-write lithography vendor but not the sole global source — competitors exist in maskless lithography and mask-writing equipment (e.g., other direct-write and e-beam/laser writer makers). No defensible sole-source claim.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level headcount at the Wieblingen HQ: Wikipedia (DE) cites ~276 employees at the main German site as of 2025; earlier IHK Magazine (06/2022) reported ~210 of ~300 total employees at the Stammsitz Heidelberg-Wieblingen. Global company headcount is ~380-400 (not site-specific).
properties.summary: Designs and builds maskless laser lithography systems and aligners for photomask making and micro patterning in Heidelberg, Germany. The site has about 276 employees.

properties.site_name: Hesse GmbH Headquarters and Production, Paderborn
properties.products: Fully automatic ultrasonic/thermosonic wire bonders (wedge-wedge bonders), ultrasonic flip-chip bonders, and high-accuracy dispensers for semiconductor back-end packaging.
properties.sole_source_note: Hesse is a notable niche player in ultrasonic wire/wedge bonding equipment but is not the sole global source — competitors include Kulicke & Soffa, ASM Pacific Technology (Netherlands), and F&K Delvotec (also Germany).
properties.employees_basis: Not officially disclosed by Hesse GmbH; third-party estimates conflict (RocketReach ~58-108, wer-zu-wem 50-99, LinkedIn/ZoomInfo 201-500). No verified site-level headcount published.
properties.summary: Builds automatic ultrasonic wire bonders, flip chip bonders and dispensers for chip packaging. The Paderborn site has about 100 employees and expansion plans.

properties.products: Precision micro-optical components, lenses, and sensor assemblies for the semiconductor lithography and photonics/optical-communications industries, produced using cleanroom (ISO 5/ISO 3) processes including e-beam lithography tooling supplied by Vistec Electron Beam GmbH (Jena).
properties.sole_source_note: No defensible sole-source claim established from available sources for this specific fab; Jenoptik is one of several precision micro-optics suppliers globally.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level, disclosed: Jenoptik states workforce at the Airportpark Dresden fab "will increase to more than 120" employees (per Jenoptik/Vistec joint press release, Jan 2024).
properties.summary: Jenoptik makes micro optical components, lenses and sensor assemblies in a Dresden cleanroom. They serve chip lithography and optical communications. The site opened in 2024.

properties.products: LPKF's global HQ and a manufacturing site for its patented LIDE (Laser-Induced Deep Etching) technology — laser micromachining systems and glass microstructure components (e.g., glass interposers/substrates) for display and semiconductor customers. LIDE tools are used in advanced packaging to create high-density via structures in glass wafers/interposers.
properties.sole_source_note: LPKF is a leading/pioneering supplier of LIDE glass-via technology but not verified as the sole global source — other glass-processing/via-etch approaches exist from competitors (e.g., some display/semi equipment makers); no defensible sole-source claim found in these queries.
properties.employees_basis: Only global headcount disclosed (~700-750 employees company-wide, per LPKF company profile / investor relations pages and LinkedIn 501-1000 range); no site-level figure for Garbsen is publicly broken out.
properties.summary: LPKF in Garbsen makes laser systems and glass components using its LIDE laser etching process. Customers include display and semiconductor makers. The site is the company headquarters.

properties.site_name: LayTec Headquarters and EpiX Manufacturing, Berlin
properties.products: In-situ and in-line optical metrology systems (EpiX-branded product line) for process control of MOCVD/epitaxy and other thin-film deposition tools used in compound-semiconductor, LED and photovoltaic manufacturing. HQ/R&D at Seesener Str. 10-13, 10709 Berlin; manufacturing of EpiX metrology systems occurs at a separate site, Eresburgstraße 24-29, 12103 Berlin, explicitly labeled by LayTec as its "EpiX manufacturing" location.
properties.sole_source_note: No documented sole-source claim found. LayTec is repeatedly described as a "leading"/"major" provider of in-situ optical metrology for MOCVD and thin-film epitaxy processes, but no source asserts it is the only supplier on Earth of any specific capability; competitors exist (e.g. k-Space Associates, Nanometrics/Onto, Philips/Aixtron-integrated systems). Not marking sole-source absent a defensible technical justification.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level breakdown not disclosed. Third-party German company profile (wer-zu-wem.de) states 64 employees in Germany (company-wide, not HQ- or plant-specific); other directories give inconsistent ranges (Kompass: 10-19; JobsinBerlin: 50-99; LinkedIn self-reported: 51-200 global). No source splits headcount between the Seesener Straße HQ and the Eresburgstraße EpiX manufacturing site.
properties.summary: Makes optical measurement systems that monitor MOCVD and thin-film growth in compound semiconductor, LED and solar production. Based in Berlin.

properties.products: Vacuum pumps, vacuum systems, pumping stations, components and measuring devices. Leybold does not publish which of them it makes at the Cologne site.
properties.sole_source_note: Leybold is a leading vacuum technology supplier to the semiconductor industry but not the only source of vacuum pumps for chip fabs (competitors include Pfeiffer Vacuum, Edwards Vacuum/Atlas Copco stablemate, Ebara).
properties.employees_basis: Only company-wide figures publicly disclosed (>1,600 per German Wikipedia; 1,001-5,000 per LinkedIn/directory listings); no site-level Cologne headcount found
properties.summary: Headquarters, production and engineering site for vacuum pumps, vacuum systems and measuring devices. Leybold GmbH is part of Atlas Copco.

properties.products: 3D laser lithography / two-photon polymerization equipment for high-precision 3D microstructuring (micro-optics, photonic and microfluidic structures)
properties.sole_source_note: Multiple vendors worldwide offer two-photon polymerization / TPP lithography systems (e.g., Nanoscribe, UpNano), so this site is not a sole source globally.
properties.employees_basis: No official site-level headcount disclosed; third-party estimates (ZoomInfo <25, PitchBook 15) are unverified and not used as authoritative
properties.summary: Builds 3D laser lithography machines using two photon polymerization in Würzburg, Germany. They make micro optics, photonic and microfluidic structures.

properties.company: Multitest Elektronische Systeme GmbH (now part of Cohu GmbH)
properties.products: Semiconductor final-test handlers (gravity and pick-and-place), strip-test systems, MEMS/sensor test and calibration handlers, final-test sockets/contactors, and semiconductor test boards/interfaces used in IC final test cells
properties.sole_source_note: Not sole source; multiple competitors (Advantest, Aetrium, Tesec, and Cohu's other product lines) make semiconductor test handlers globally. No defensible unique-on-Earth claim.
properties.employees_basis: Company-wide range of 200-499 employees reported by Europages directory listing for Multitest Elektronische Systeme GmbH; not site-specific and undated, so treat as a rough midpoint estimate rather than a disclosed site figure
properties.summary: Makes final test handlers, test sockets and test boards for packaged chips, including MEMS sensor handlers. The Rosenheim plant belongs to Cohu and has 350 employees.

properties.site_name: Nanoscribe Headquarters (ZEISS Innovation Hub @ KIT Campus North)
properties.products: Two-photon polymerization (2PP) lithography / maskless 3D microfabrication and micro-3D-printing systems used for high-resolution R&D and industrial micro-optics, MEMS, and photonics prototyping; company also develops proprietary photoresists for these systems. This site is stated by Nanoscribe as housing both development and production of "the next generation of industrial microfabrication equipment."
properties.sole_source_note: Nanoscribe is a leading/pioneering vendor of commercial two-photon polymerization lithography systems but not the only maker of 2PP or maskless microfabrication tools globally (competitors and academic-origin systems exist), so sole-source status is not defensible from available evidence.
properties.employees_basis: No site-specific figure disclosed. Company-wide headcount estimates vary by source: PitchBook (2025) 73 employees; life-sciences directory ~80 employees (banded 51-100, 2021); Nanoscribe/LinkedIn marketing copy "over 100 employees." All appear to be company-wide (HQ plus US/China subsidiaries), not HQ-site-specific.
properties.summary: Nanoscribe builds two photon polymerization systems for maskless 3D micro printing at Eggenstein-Leopoldshafen, Germany. They are used for micro optics, MEMS and photonics prototypes.

properties.site_name: PVA TePla Analytical Systems GmbH — Westhausen (SAM manufacturing/application center)
properties.products: Scanning acoustic microscopy (SAM) systems for non-destructive inspection of semiconductor packages/dies and materials — including automated wafer/bond-inspection systems (e.g. Auto Wafer line). Site is the company's manufacturing and application center for SAM equipment (part of PVA TePla AG's Metrology division).
properties.sole_source_note: Not sole source — multiple SAM equipment makers exist globally (e.g. Nordson SONOSCAN, Hitachi, Sonix). No defensible sole-source claim.
properties.employees_basis: No official site-level disclosure. Third-party estimates conflict: Prospeo.io lists 21-50 employees (23 across 5 departments, scraped/estimated); Leichtbauatlas organization profile lists 50-249 employees (likely broader/less current). Treat as unverified order-of-magnitude only — omitting a specific employees figure.
properties.summary: PVA TePla Analytical Systems in Westhausen builds scanning acoustic microscopes. They inspect chip packages, dies and wafers without damaging them. The site is also its application center.

properties.products: Vacuum pumps and related vacuum technology components (Pfeiffer's overall portfolio spans turbopumps, backing pumps — rotary vane, multi-stage Roots, dry process, scroll — leak detectors, and vacuum measurement/analysis equipment used in semiconductor and other high-vacuum applications); no source specifies which specific product line is manufactured at the Dresden site itself.
properties.sole_source_note: Pfeiffer is one of several major global vacuum pump manufacturers (competitors include Edwards/Atlas Copco, Busch, Leybold/Atlas Copco); no basis found for a sole-source claim for this site.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount disclosed; only group-wide figures are public (3,309 employees worldwide as of Dec 2020 per 2020 annual report; ~3,847 worldwide per 2026 AGM material). No Dresden-specific number exists in any public filing.
properties.summary: Production site for vacuum pumps and related vacuum parts. Pfeiffer Vacuum also sells leak detectors and vacuum measurement tools.

properties.site_name: Pfeiffer Vacuum Components & Solutions GmbH (Pfeiffer Vacuum+Fab Solutions) — Göttingen production plant
properties.products: Custom and standard vacuum components, tailor-made vacuum chambers, and customer-specific complete vacuum systems (incl. controls and service) for applications spanning semiconductor manufacturing, space simulation, energy storage, hydrogen tanks, and forensic detection systems.
properties.sole_source_note: Not sole source; multiple competitors (VAT Group, Leybold, ULVAC, Ideal Vacuum, etc.) manufacture comparable custom vacuum chambers and components for chip-industry and other vacuum applications.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level headcount ("team of 150 employees") stated by the site operator (Pfeiffer Vacuum+Fab Solutions / Pfeiffer Vacuum Components & Solutions GmbH) on its own about page and repeated in a regional business directory; not from an audited annual report.
properties.summary: Builds custom vacuum chambers, components and complete vacuum systems for chip making and other uses. The site has about 150 employees.

properties.products: Turbomolecular pumps (hybrid and magnetically levitated bearings), dry and rotary vane backing pumps, leak detectors, vacuum measurement and analysis devices, vacuum systems and chambers — core enabling vacuum technology for semiconductor front-end process tools (deposition, etch, ion implant chambers all require sub-atmospheric vacuum maintained by these pumps).
properties.sole_source_note: Pfeiffer Vacuum is one of several global turbomolecular pump makers (competitors include Edwards Vacuum/Atlas Copco UK, Leybold Germany, Osaka Vacuum Japan, Ebara Japan), so not a sole source globally, though it is a major European vacuum-technology manufacturer and this is its primary production site for the segment.
properties.employees_basis: Not disclosed at site level; public sources (ZoomInfo, corporate filings) give only company-wide global headcount range (1K-5K employees), with no Asslar-specific breakout found.
properties.summary: Pfeiffer Vacuum headquarters and factory in Aßlar, Germany, making turbomolecular (high vacuum) pumps, backing pumps and leak detectors. Chip tools for deposition and etch need such pumps.

properties.site_name: QuantumDiamonds Munich (HQ/R&D at Fraunhoferstrasse 17; new production plant under construction in Weisses Quartier, eastern Munich)
properties.products: NV-diamond quantum sensing chips/wafers and Quantum Diamond Microscopy (QDM) metrology/inspection systems for semiconductor chip failure analysis and inline inspection
properties.sole_source_note: Described in press as building the "world's first" dedicated production plant for advanced chip test systems using NV-diamond quantum sensing, but no independently verified claim that QuantumDiamonds is the only global source for a specific chip-manufacturing-critical input; not asserting sole_source.
properties.employees_basis: LinkedIn company profile lists 11-50 employees company-wide (not site-specific); midpoint estimate, low confidence
properties.summary: Develops quantum diamond microscopes that find faults in chips. A production plant in Munich is under construction, and the company has about 30 employees.

properties.site_name: RENA Technologies Headquarters and Main Production, Gütenbach
properties.products: Wet chemical surface processing equipment for semiconductor and solar wafer manufacturing (batch and single-wafer wet processing/cleaning/etch/texturing tools); company material states >100 machines produced per year at this site combined with a related Swiss facility, on >10,000 m² production area. Site is the development and manufacturing base for RENA's wet processing systems.
properties.sole_source_note: RENA is a significant player in wet chemical processing equipment for semiconductor/solar wafers but is not established as the only source on Earth for any specific chip-production-critical process; competitors exist in wet processing equipment (e.g., SEMES, ASYS, and others).
properties.employees_basis: RENA's own "RENA Germany" company page states approx. 560 employees, in context of the Gütenbach headquarters/German operations — not a strictly site-isolated figure but the closest company-disclosed basis. Company-wide figures (700 per an official image folder; ~1,100-1,200 per Wikipedia/PitchBook) are broader and not site-specific, so were excluded.
properties.summary: RENA develops and builds wet chemical cleaning, etch and texturing tools for semiconductor and solar wafers in Gütenbach, Germany. The site employs about 560 people.

properties.products: Electron beam lithography (EBL), focused ion beam (FIB), and laser lithography nanofabrication systems, plus related nanoengineering/reverse-engineering tools; corporate purpose per commercial register (HRB 8984) explicitly includes design and manufacture of mechanical, electronic, and electron-optical products
properties.sole_source_note: Not established as sole source; Raith is one of several EBL/FIB nanofabrication toolmakers globally. No defensible unique-on-Earth claim found.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount disclosed. Only global/group figures found: LinkedIn states "more than 200 people" (201-500 employee band); PitchBook and ZoomInfo report ~386-390 total employees company-wide, not broken out by location.
properties.summary: Raith in Dortmund builds electron beam lithography, focused ion beam and laser lithography systems for nanofabrication. The site is the company headquarters.

properties.products: Gravity-feed and strip IC test handlers for semiconductor final test (including MEMS-capable and thermal subsystem configurations), designed and manufactured at this site.
properties.sole_source_note: Rasco/Cohu is a specialized but not sole-source supplier of IC test handlers; other handler makers exist globally (e.g., Advantest, Yamaha Robotics, Ismeca/Tegra). No defensible sole-source claim.
properties.employees_basis: PitchBook company profile lists Rasco GmbH at ~400 total employees (company-wide, not confirmed as site-specific to Kolbermoor); no Cohu SEC filing or company disclosure breaks out Kolbermoor site headcount separately. Treat as approximate company-level figure, likely close to site total since Kolbermoor appears to be Rasco's only site.
properties.summary: Designs and makes IC test handlers for final test, including MEMS (micro machined sensor) and thermal versions. Part of Cohu. Around 400 employees.

properties.site_name: SENTECH Instruments GmbH — Berlin-Adlershof HQ, R&D & Manufacturing
properties.products: Plasma etch systems (including ICP-RIE), PECVD (plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition) systems, ALD (atomic layer deposition) equipment, and thin-film metrology tools (spectroscopic ellipsometers, laser ellipsometers, spectroscopic reflectometers) used in semiconductor, MEMS, and photovoltaics process development and production. Company states a new production facility on the Adlershof campus was completed in 2020 to expand manufacturing capacity.
properties.sole_source_note: Not a defensible sole-source claim; SENTECH competes with multiple other ICP-RIE/PECVD/ALD and ellipsometry equipment makers (e.g., Oxford Instruments, SPTS, Aixtron, Semilab, J.A. Woollam).
properties.employees_basis: Company/Silicon Saxony member profile states "over 120" to "over 130 employees" for the whole company; since the company states all systems are designed/manufactured/shipped from this single Berlin-Adlershof site, this figure is treated as effectively site-level headcount. LinkedIn (51-200), wlw.com (50-99) and Kompass (10-19) directory listings are less reliable/outdated.
properties.summary: Designs and builds plasma etch, PECVD and ALD systems plus ellipsometers for thin-film measurement. SENTECH has about 125 employees at this Berlin site.

properties.products: Mask aligners, coater and developer systems, wafer bonders and wet-processing systems. SUSS MicroTec does not publish which of them it makes at Garching.
properties.sole_source_note: No defensible sole-source claim found; SUSS MicroTec competes with other lithography/bonding equipment makers (EVG, ASML, etc.) in overlapping niches.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount disclosed; only company-wide estimates (~779-1,498 employees) found across third-party sources (RocketReach, ZoomInfo, PitchBook), not attributable to Garching specifically
properties.summary: Headquarters in Garching, Germany, of SUSS MicroTec, which makes mask aligners, coater and developer systems and wafer bonders. SUSS does not publish which of them it makes at the site.

properties.products: Wafer/substrate bonders, coater and developer systems (incl. spin coaters), and photomask processing/wet-processing equipment. Company materials describe Sternenfels as SUSS MicroTec's competence center for wet processing technology and wafer bonding. Mask aligners/lithography exposure systems are developed and produced at Garching (HQ), not Sternenfels.
properties.sole_source_note: No defensible sole-source claim found; SUSS MicroTec competes with other wafer bonding and coat/develop equipment makers globally (e.g., EV Group for bonding).
properties.employees_basis: Historical, site-specific figure (~270 employees, ~50 temporary) from a SUSS MicroTec Sternenfels analyst-day investor presentation (PDF, early 2010s). No current (2023-2025) site-level headcount is publicly disclosed; only group-wide total (1,498 employees FY2024) is available. Directory sources (Kompass, "50-99 employees") conflict and likely reflect only one legal subsidiary, not the full site.
properties.summary: Makes wafer bonders, coater and developer systems and wet processing equipment. SUSS MicroTec calls Sternenfels its competence center for wet processing and wafer bonding.

properties.products: TRUMPF group headquarters, and the site of the EUV drive-laser building that TRUMPF announced in 2015 for ASML's lithography machines.
properties.sole_source_note: Not flagged as sole source. TRUMPF calls its relationship with ASML a 'close and exclusive partnership' (TRUMPF release, 24 Oct 2025), but no source found states that TRUMPF is the only supplier of EUV drive lasers. TRUMPF announced a EUR 70m building at Ditzingen to make EUV lasers for ASML (optics.org, 2015).
properties.employees_basis: Only global TRUMPF group figure disclosed (18,352 employees, FY2022/23, per Wikipedia/company profile); no site-specific Ditzingen headcount is publicly disclosed.
properties.summary: Ditzingen, Germany, is the headquarters of TRUMPF, a maker of industrial lasers. TRUMPF announced a €70 million building here in 2015 for EUV lasers for ASML.

properties.company: TRUMPF Hüttinger GmbH + Co. KG (TRUMPF group)
properties.products: RF/DC/MF generators and process power supplies for plasma applications (used in semiconductor etch/deposition tools), plus industrial heating, battery inverter systems, and microwave generators/amplifiers. This is the global headquarters, development, and manufacturing site for TRUMPF Hüttinger, a supplier of critical power-delivery subsystems used inside plasma-based chipmaking equipment (e.g., etch/PECVD tools from OEMs like Applied Materials, Lam Research).
properties.sole_source_note: TRUMPF Hüttinger is one of several major suppliers of RF/plasma power delivery systems (competitors include Advanced Energy, MKS/ENI, COMET). Not a sole source.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount figure was found in public sources; only company-wide/group figures exist for TRUMPF Hüttinger and its parent TRUMPF Group.
properties.summary: TRUMPF Huttinger in Freiburg makes RF and DC power generators for plasma etch and deposition tools. The site is the headquarters, with development and manufacturing.

properties.site_name: VON ARDENNE Dresden (HQ, central production, Technology & Application Center)
properties.products: Vacuum coating systems: PVD sputtering equipment, thermal evaporation systems, and vacuum coating processes/tools for semiconductor wafers, glass, photovoltaic (PV), and metal strip substrates.
properties.sole_source_note: No defensible sole-source claim found; VON ARDENNE is one of several PVD/vacuum coating equipment makers globally (competitors include Applied Materials, Buhler Leybold, etc.), so sole_source is not asserted.
properties.employees_basis: No company-published site-level headcount found. Kompass (third-party directory) lists a size band of 500-999 employees for the Dresden entity; ZoomInfo lists 797 employees company-wide. Neither is an authoritative site-specific disclosure, so no employees figure is reported.
properties.summary: Headquarters and main factory for vacuum coating systems, including PVD (physical vapor deposition) sputtering, for wafers, glass and solar cells.

properties.site_name: Vistec Electron Beam GmbH — Jena plant
properties.products: Electron-beam lithography (EBL) systems / mask writers based on Variable Shaped Beam (VSB) technology, 50 kV, for 200mm/300mm platforms — used for silicon direct write, mask making, compound semiconductor, silicon photonics, and advanced research applications.
properties.sole_source_note: Not established as sole-source; Vistec is one of a small number of EBL mask writer makers globally (e.g. also NuFlare/Toshiba, IMS Nanofabrication for other e-beam segments), so exclusivity claim is not defensible from available sources.
properties.employees_basis: Global/company-wide headcount (~110), not site-specific; Jena described as "main location" (Hidden Champions Thuringia profile). No official Jena-only breakdown is publicly disclosed.
properties.summary: Headquarters and factory for electron beam lithography systems and mask writers. They use variable shaped beams at 50 kV and handle 200 and 300 mm wafers.

properties.products: Thermal processing and PECVD/LPCVD production equipment — diffusion furnaces, firing furnaces, PECVD systems — mainly for solar cell/wafer manufacturing, with broader positioning toward semiconductor/microelectronics process technology.
properties.sole_source_note: No evidence this site is the sole global source of any specific chip-production input; thermal/PECVD furnace equipment has multiple alternative suppliers worldwide (e.g., Tempress, SPTS, Applied Materials).
properties.employees_basis: Only global/company-wide figures found (~600 employees per centrotherm's own Blaubeuren town profile; 665/755 per third-party databases ZoomInfo/PitchBook); no site-specific headcount disclosed for Blaubeuren alone.
properties.summary: Headquarters and factory in Blaubeuren, Germany, making diffusion furnaces, firing furnaces and PECVD (plasma chemical vapour deposition) systems. The equipment mainly serves solar cell production.

properties.site_name: scia Systems GmbH Headquarters / R&D / Manufacturing
properties.products: Ion beam etching (IBE) and ion beam sputtering (IBS) thin-film process equipment based on ion beam and plasma technologies, for microelectronics, MEMS, and precision optics applications — both R&D and high-volume production tools.
properties.sole_source_note: No defensible sole-source claim found; scia is one of several ion beam etching/sputtering equipment makers (others include Veeco, Oxford Instruments, Intlvac) — not the only source on Earth for IBE/IBS tools.
properties.employees_basis: Not disclosed at precise/audited level by the company itself. Best-supported public estimate (~250) from a local Chemnitz industry portal (industriekultur-chemnitz.de), stating ~250 employees and ~€70M annual revenue, broadly consistent with LinkedIn's self-reported 201–500 band. Other directories (ZoomInfo ~55, Kompass 10–19) appear outdated/unreliable and are not used as the basis.
properties.summary: Builds ion beam etching and ion beam sputtering tools for microelectronics, MEMS and optics. The Chemnitz site is headquarters, research and production, with 250 employees.

properties.products: Semiconductor and photovoltaic material/wafer characterization and metrology equipment (e.g., optical, photoluminescence, and related physical measurement tools used for wafer/material inspection in chip and solar cell production)
properties.sole_source_note: No defensible sole-source claim found; metrology/characterization equipment of this type has multiple global suppliers (e.g., KLA, Nova, Bruker), so Semilab is not the only source on Earth for any specific chip-production-critical function per available evidence.
properties.employees_basis: Global headcount (not site-specific) from a third-party industrial directory (Metoree, ~1,118 employees); a SEMI trade-show exhibitor listing separately states >235 physicists and >577 engineers worldwide (>=812 technical staff). No official site-level Budapest headcount is disclosed.
properties.summary: Semilab in Budapest makes metrology tools that measure wafer and material properties for chip and solar cell production. They include optical and photoluminescence instruments.

properties.products: Epitaxial reactors for silicon and silicon carbide (SiC) power-device applications: ACiS M8 and ACiS M10 hot-wall SiC epitaxial reactors, and PE1O8 (200mm SiC single-wafer hot-wall automatic CVD reactor); also SiC bulk growth reactors. Used for thick epi applications in power management, sensors, and epitaxial MEMS.
properties.sole_source_note: LPE is a specialist SiC/Si epitaxy equipment maker but competes with other epi reactor vendors (e.g., Aixtron, Applied Materials, NAURA, TEL); not the only source on Earth for epitaxial reactors, though it is a notable niche player recently acquired by ASM International.
properties.employees_basis: Company-wide (not site-specific) headcount; PitchBook lists 154 total employees (~2025), corroborated by Italian registries (FatturatoItalia, Aziende.it, ImpresaItalia) placing LPE in the 100-249 range and ZoomInfo at 51-200. No source breaks headcount down by site (Baranzate vs. Catania).
properties.summary: LPE in Baranzate makes epitaxy reactors that grow crystal layers on silicon and SiC (silicon carbide) power-device wafers. This includes a 200 mm SiC reactor. About 154 staff.

properties.products: Automatic test equipment (ATE) designed and built at this plant: SoC/IC semiconductor testers, MEMS test cells (with rotating/pressure/magnetic stimulus for inertial, pressure, magnetic MEMS), power module (MOS/IGBT) test cells, flying-probe and in-circuit PCB testers, EV/consumer battery test systems, plus pick-and-place and reel-to-reel handlers.
properties.sole_source_note: SPEA is a notable ATE vendor for MEMS/IC/module test but not the sole global source for any of these equipment categories; multiple competitors (Advantest, Teradyne, Cohu, etc.) exist.
properties.employees_basis: Site-level: "more than 950" employees at the Volpiano plant per Exclusive Brands Torino profile; corroborated by legal-entity registry data showing 976 employees (2025, ufficiocamerale.it) and 500-999 band (fatturatoitalia.it). Company-wide total is 1,200+.
properties.summary: Builds automatic test equipment for chips, MEMS sensors and power modules, plus circuit board testers. Headquarters and plant employ more than 950 people.

properties.products: Global headquarters and an R&D site for ASM's deposition equipment: ALD, epitaxy, PECVD and vertical furnaces. ASM's main production is in Singapore and South Korea.
properties.sole_source_note: ASM International is a leading global supplier of ALD equipment but not the sole source - competitors like Applied Materials and Tokyo Electron also make ALD/deposition tools. No defensible sole-source claim for this site.
properties.employees_basis: No verified site-level headcount. Kompass directory lists an address-level estimate of 20-49 employees for the ASM International N.V. entity at Versterkerstraat 8, but this is inconsistent with the company's global headcount (3,300-4,542 across sources) and not clearly labeled as HQ/R&D staff only - treated as unreliable directory noise, not a citable site figure. Global 2021 Wikipedia figure is 3,312 staff across 14 countries.
properties.summary: Headquarters and research site of ASM International. ASM makes deposition equipment, including ALD (atomic layer deposition), epitaxy and vertical furnace systems.

properties.products: EUV and DUV lithography systems — development, assembly, system integration, and testing of complete lithography machines (from prototype through production units) before shipment to customer fabs. ASML explicitly describes Veldhoven as its "biggest R&D and manufacturing site," where its Manufacturing and Planning department "assembles, builds and delivers all our systems from the prototype stage onwards." Subsystem-level manufacturing (e.g., which specific components like wafer stages are built on-site vs. sourced from suppliers or other ASML/partner factories) is not broken out in public sources.
properties.sole_source_note: ASML is the sole global manufacturer of EUV lithography systems (the only company producing machines capable of EUV patterning required for leading-edge chip nodes), and Veldhoven is ASML's largest R&D and system-assembly/integration site for both EUV and DUV lithography platforms.
properties.employees_basis: Not disclosed at site level. ASML publishes only global headcount (~44,175 employees, 2025, per Wikipedia); no official ASML source breaks out Veldhoven-specific employee count. LinkedIn shows a "1,001-5,000" band for the ASML Netherlands B.V. legal entity, but that is a rough entity-wide estimate, not a verified Veldhoven-site figure, so no employees value is reported.
properties.summary: ASML headquarters in Veldhoven, Netherlands, where it builds and tests EUV and DUV (extreme and deep ultraviolet) lithography machines. ASML calls it its biggest R&D and manufacturing site.

properties.site_name: ASML-imec High-NA EUV Lithography Lab, Veldhoven
properties.products: High-NA EUV lithography process development: prototype scanner access (TWINSCAN EXE:5000), patterning R&D for logic and DRAM structures, integration/testing of surrounding process and metrology tools for High-NA EUV adoption.
properties.sole_source_note: Joint ASML-imec process-development laboratory, not a supplier manufacturing EUV scanners. ASML’s supplier position belongs to the separate Veldhoven manufacturing record.
properties.employees_basis: No site-specific headcount disclosed. Only company-wide totals exist: ASML >42,700 FTE globally; imec >5,500 employees/researchers globally. Neither source breaks out lab staffing.
properties.summary: Joint ASML and imec lab, opened in 2024, with a prototype High-NA EUV scanner (TWINSCAN EXE:5000). Used for patterning research, not volume production.

properties.site_name: Besi Duiven (Besi Netherlands B.V. / Group HQ)
properties.products: Fico-branded advanced packaging/back-end assembly equipment: molding systems, trim & form equipment, laser markers, and singulation systems for leadframe and array-connect substrate packaging; also serves as group HQ with product development/R&D for die and wire bonders and packaging equipment lines.
properties.sole_source_note: Besi is one of a small number of leading die/wire bonding and advanced packaging equipment makers (alongside ASMPT, Kulicke & Soffa, etc.); not the only source of this equipment class.
properties.employees_basis: Third-party estimate (Prospeo.io) specific to Besi Netherlands B.V. at Duiven ("226 employees across 15 departments"); not an official Besi disclosure. Besi's own reporting is only at global group level (~1,800-1,900 employees).
properties.summary: Besi's headquarters in Duiven, Netherlands, makes Fico molding, trim and form, laser marking and singulation tools for chip packaging. Besi does the R&D for its die and wire bonders here.

properties.products: Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) wafer coating/processing systems for semiconductor and photovoltaic (solar cell) manufacturing; also rapid thermal processing (RTP)/conductive heating equipment per Craft profile
properties.employees_basis: Company-wide (not site-specific) headcount ~30-40; PitchBook lists 32 total employees, LinkedIn/Kompass show 11-50/20-49 ranges. No site-level breakdown found; since HQ/production is the company's sole significant site, this figure is a reasonable proxy but not explicitly labeled site-level.
properties.summary: Levitech in Almere makes atomic layer deposition systems that coat wafers, for semiconductor and solar cell production. The company has about 32 staff.

properties.products: Control cabinets and control systems manufactured for the TRUMPF Group, including for the semiconductor industry. TRUMPF Hüttinger's core product line is RF/plasma power generators used in semiconductor deposition and etch equipment, but this specific site's stated output is control cabinets/control systems, not the power generators themselves.
properties.sole_source_note: No defensible sole-source claim: this is a control-cabinet/control-systems manufacturing site, not a unique upstream chokepoint technology.
properties.employees_basis: Company-stated figure for TRUMPF Hüttinger's overall Poland workforce (over 1,500 employees) as of the July 2023 CTP announcement, not disclosed specifically for the Kobyłka site alone; company also stated a plan to grow to more than 3,000 employees within five years. A separate third-party (EMIS) profile lists 654 employees (2021) for TRUMPF Huettinger Sp. z o.o., an older and likely non-comparable figure.
properties.summary: Builds control cabinets and control systems for the TRUMPF Group, including chip industry uses. About 1,500 people work for TRUMPF Hüttinger in Poland.

employees.note: 1,500 is TRUMPF Huettinger's total in Poland (ctp.eu), not Kobylka alone.

year_opened.note: 2023 is the lease date at CTPark Warsaw East (ctp.eu); the opening year was not found.

properties.products: Generators for plasma processes and industrial heating, and control cabinets, for TRUMPF Hüttinger.
properties.sole_source_note: No defensible sole-source claim found for this site; TRUMPF Huettinger is one of several RF/plasma power-supply makers globally (e.g. MKS/ENI, Advanced Energy also compete in this space)
properties.employees_basis: EMIS company profile figure for Trumpf Huettinger Sp. z o.o. (headquartered at this Zielonka address), dated 2021; treated as effectively site/entity-level since EMIS lists Zielonka as HQ, but not explicitly broken out from other Polish TRUMPF Huettinger locations (Kobylka, Warsaw)
properties.summary: Makes power generators and control cabinets for plasma, industrial heating and radio-frequency uses. The Polish entity of TRUMPF Hüttinger had 654 employees in 2021.

properties.site_name: Pfeiffer Vacuum Srl Production Plant Apahida
properties.products: Vacuum pump components (turbomolecular and backing pump components) and vacuum pumps (molecular/turbomolecular, oil-free, reciprocating, diaphragm, customer-specific)
properties.sole_source_note: Not sole-source: multiple vacuum pump manufacturers exist globally (e.g., Edwards, Leybold/Busch subsidiaries, Agilent, Ebara); this is a component/assembly plant within a larger multinational vacuum-technology supplier, not a unique global source.
properties.employees_basis: Approximate; no precise official site figure disclosed. Third-party company registries give a range: EMIS reports 142 employees (2022) and Targetare.ro reports 116 employees for the Pfeiffer Vacuum Romania SRL legal entity headquartered at this address; Kompass classifies the address as 100-249 employees. A 2019 news article on the plant opening cited 74 employees at the time. These figures are for the Romanian legal entity/site combined, not a separately audited site-only FTE count, so treat as indicative.
properties.summary: Production plant for turbomolecular (high vacuum) pump components and vacuum pumps in Apahida, Romania. About 120 people work there.

properties.company: VAT Group AG — VAT Romania SRL
properties.site_name: VAT Romania SRL — Arad (legacy plant: Str. I, Zona Industrială Arad Vest nr. 9; new plant: VGP Park Arad, DN 69 KM 46+215)
properties.products: Vacuum valves and related parts for chip making, displays, solar and research.
properties.sole_source_note: VAT Group is a global leader in vacuum valves for semiconductor manufacturing but not the sole source — competitors exist (e.g., MKS Instruments/Vacuum Research, Presto Engineering, Pfeiffer Vacuum for adjacent products). No defensible single-source claim for this specific Arad site.
properties.employees_basis: VAT Group press release (June 4, 2025): "around 380 highly qualified employees at VAT Romania," of which ~50 were at the new VGP Park site initially, with plan to relocate all to VGP Park by end of 2025. Registry sources (EMIS, MetricBiz) show ~282-298 employees in 2022; figure is company-wide for Romania operations, not split by building.
properties.summary: Makes vacuum valves for chip, display and solar production. The Arad site opened in 2001, a new plant opened in June 2025, and it has 380 employees.

properties.products: Non-contact 3D optical surface profilers and metrology instruments using confocal, interferometric, focus-variation and thin-film/spectroscopy reflectometer techniques (e.g. S neox, PLu apex series), used for surface metrology including semiconductor and MEMS inspection. Includes an assembly clean room for sensor heads plus vibration-free, temperature-controlled production areas.
properties.sole_source_note: Sensofar is one of several optical/confocal 3D surface metrology vendors (competitors include KLA/Zygo, Bruker, Keyence, Nanofocus); not a sole source for any chip-production-critical function.
properties.employees_basis: Company-wide headcount only (51-100 employees per Prospeo directory listing, not broken out for the Terrassa site specifically); treat as approximate lower bound, not a site-specific figure
properties.summary: Sensofar in Terrassa, Spain, builds non-contact 3D optical surface profilers. They use confocal and interferometric methods and are used to inspect semiconductor and MEMS parts.

properties.site_name: Mycronic AB Headquarters / Pattern Generators Division, Täby
properties.products: Laser pattern generators (mask writers) and measuring machines for photomask production used in semiconductor and display manufacturing, developed and (per company description) manufactured by the Pattern Generators division based at this HQ site.
properties.sole_source_note: Mycronic is a leading but not sole-source supplier of laser mask writers for photomasks; other mask-writing equipment makers exist globally (e.g., in Japan/US), so sole_source is not defensible.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount disclosed; only global company figures exist (~2,000-2,231 employees group-wide, per Mycronic career page and stockanalysis.com). Omitted per instructions.
properties.summary: Mycronic in Taby, Sweden, develops and builds laser mask writers and measuring machines for photomask production. They serve semiconductor and display makers. The site is its headquarters.

properties.products: Nanoimprint lithography (NIL) systems for micro/nano-scale patterning; R&D in nanolithography technology at the Lund site.
properties.sole_source_note: Obducat is one of a small number of NIL equipment suppliers (alongside e.g. EV Group, SUSS MicroTec, Canon) — not a sole source for any chip-production input.
properties.employees_basis: Company-level (not site-specific) headcount from third-party financial profiles (largestcompanies.com / marketscreener range 42-46); LinkedIn shows a broader 51-200 company-size band. No site-level figure disclosed publicly.
properties.summary: Makes nanoimprint lithography systems that press fine patterns into a coating. Headquarters and R&D are in Lund. About 46 employees.

properties.site_name: Attolight HQ / R&D-Manufacturing Site (EPFL Innovation Park)
properties.products: Cathodoluminescence (CL) metrology and in-line defect inspection tools for silicon and compound-semiconductor (e.g. GaN) wafers, including automated full-wafer CL inspection systems. Attolight, an EPFL spin-off, designs and builds them at Ecublens.
properties.sole_source_note: Sources describe Attolight as "the leader" / "an emerging leader" in quantitative CL equipment and defect inspection, but no source claims exclusivity. Other CL-capable SEM/TEM add-ons and niche competitors exist in the broader electron-microscopy/spectroscopy market, so sole_source cannot be justified from available evidence.
properties.employees_basis: No site-level headcount disclosed. Company-wide LinkedIn profile lists "11-50 employees" (used midpoint as rough indicator); ZoomInfo estimates revenue <$5M. Not a verified site-specific figure — treat as approximate company-wide size, likely mostly concentrated at this single site.
